kehidupan.title: Life in the Prophet's City
kehidupan.description: Experience the joy of learning Islamic knowledge and technology in the Prophet's City. Comfortable dormitory, near Masjid Nabawi, guaranteed meals, and monthly umrah.
kehidupan.subtitle: Experiencing the bliss of worship, peaceful learning, and Islamic brotherhood in a blessed environment.
kehidupan.paragraf_1: Markaz IT student life is designed to balance spiritual, intellectual, and social needs. The day begins before Fajr with preparation for congregational prayer at Masjid Nabawi.
kehidupan.paragraf_2: After Fajr, students join Quran tahfidz halaqah. Morning to afternoon is filled with intensive Arabic and IT classes. Afternoon is for muraja'ah, Dars Masyaikh, and rest.
kehidupan.umrah_desc: Every month, students are facilitated to perform Umrah to Makkah using AC buses (approximately 4-5 hours land journey from Madinah).
kehidupan.fasilitas_subtitle: Comfort that supports your learning success

fasilitas.title: Comfortable Accommodation
fasilitas.desc: Clean, air-conditioned dormitory equipped with high-speed WiFi to support IT learning.

fasilitas.title: Guaranteed Meals
fasilitas.desc: 3 meals a day with nutritious menu tailored to Indonesian taste.

fasilitas.title: Supervising Musyrif
fasilitas.desc: Accompanied by a musyrif (mentor) who is a student of the Islamic University of Madinah 24 hours a day.

fasilitas.title: Transportation & Umrah
fasilitas.desc: Transportation available for learning activities and monthly umrah schedule from Madinah to Makkah.
